verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public REST API with an API reference and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. It also has a dedicated Status Page API, an audit-logs API and an MCP server, so a broad programmatic surface exists. Nothing claims parity with the UI, and the Terraform provider is still being built out resource by resource, which suggests coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: an explicit claim or proof of API/UI feature parity, documented API coverage of core UI workflows (incident declaration, timeline editing, schedules, escalation paths, follow-ups, insights), independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
